name: Know-how
description: Your procedures, written once, answering questions and walking people through each step: each answer and procedure is a Markdown page under /know-how/<topic>/ with an owner and a check date. The Lemma answers from them wherever people ask, with one line saying which page and who checked it when. A question it can't answer goes to the topic's owner, whose reply comes back as a draft page saved in one step. Procedures are walked one step at a time. Customers get only checked, in-date answers.

knowhow_slug.description: Public URL slug for the Know-how app (unique platform-wide; a suffix is added on collision)
